2026-10-19 用户指定版：原 Turbo 加速 LoRA＋LOW4→learned 1.2×→HIGH4 保留；仅去掉 Prompt Relay，改普通完整提示词。
在“完整提示词 · 只改这里”修改文字，两采共用同一字符串，各自在本阶段尺寸重新编码。默认保留原红衣女子走到右门前并说“你好，今天真不错。”；框含义与不显示框的要求都在普通提示词内。
两阶段原底模/Qwen/VAE、Turbo LoRA强度1、种子、sigma配方、低显存分块、EAV report_only、3D潜空间放大器和原生音轨保持。HIGH尺寸仍取放大器实际输出，不能用手填尺寸替代。
124帧生成裁切120帧/24fps/5秒；原4+4两阶段不是16步单采。
框图只接参考图，不锁首尾帧。换图后重新框选并同步修改提示词里的人物/颜色/目标位置。已有手绘框图用provided_marked。
本新普通提示词路径尚待GPU成片和人工去框验收，不继承旧Relay样片质量通过；不显示框是语义要求，不保证去框。
旧图不覆盖。方法来源 RK-BoilingPoint/H3-Visual-Marker-Control；不是作者16步方案的严格复现。

A single adult East Asian woman matching <Picture 1>, short black hair, a red sweater, dark blue jeans and white sneakers. A bright plain room with pale wood floor and a closed wooden door on the far right. Full-body fixed wide shot, natural daylight, one continuous shot. Natural Mandarin speech and soft footsteps with quiet room tone. No subtitles, music or extra people.

The woman starts at the left. She walks calmly to the clear floor immediately in front of the right-side door, stops with both feet in that floor area, turns toward the camera and says clearly in Mandarin exactly once: <d>你好，今天真不错。</d> Then she remains there.

The cyan outline identifies the woman in the red sweater. The yellow outline marks her final destination: the clear floor immediately in front of the closed door on the right. She must arrive at that destination before speaking and remain there afterwards.

Both colored outlines are off-scene annotations for identifying the person and her destination, never physical objects or decorations. Render the woman and the room without colored outlines. When the movement starts, omit annotation strokes from the generated scene: no cyan rectangle attached to her body, no yellow rectangle on the floor, no floating outlines or graphic overlays. Preserve the specified destination even though its outline is not rendered.
